crossRefs.note: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.
translations.bsb: When they could not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem to search for Him.
translations.kjv: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
translations.asv: and when they found him not, they returned to Jerusalem, seeking for him.
